target: MAZ-543A; target year/batch not established by these images

sources.creator: Michael Benolkin
sources.view: Vehicle right cab, close side view, front toward image right
observations: A continuous lower step spans beneath both closed doors. Three visible suspending members descend below the fixed lower cab edge; two end members curve into the lower step while one central member remains comparatively straight.

Each visible suspension member has changes in section/appearance. Bright diagonal or twisted texture is visible on intermediate portions; flexible wire-rope construction is a hypothesis, not a confirmed part specification.

There is a broad continuous fixed sill between the door lower outlines and cab bottom. Visible suspension members begin below that lower body edge; no visible member continues upward across the closed door surface.

Multiple raised heads follow the fixed lower/rear diagonal side-skin margin outside the rear door gap. Other heads form a lower fixed-sill row; small points are also present near door edges. They must not all be indiscriminately mapped to one generic rivet pattern.
limits: Gallery identifies MAZ-543 SCUD TEL at Imperial War Museum, Duxford; does not independently prove MAZ-543A or target 1977 batch.
Oblique single-view image; no metric calibration, exact head type/count, fastener shanks, hidden upper attachments, cable material or suspension stiffness established.
Museum rope crosses lower hanging structure; some details are occluded.

recommendation: Treat the photographed continuous fixed sill and below-sill hanging step as qualitative topology constraints. Do not force a step hanger through a door shell merely to preserve inherited fitted coordinates.

Do not delete original parts to reduce contact counts. The photos cannot establish that the historical cylinders were formally superseded. Preserve source identities and old geometry, then study a traceable candidate assembly with separately justified hangers, step and fixed sill.

Resolve sill and door-aperture contour before fastener placement. Place each candidate fastener only on its supported fixed or moving substrate with a documented attachment relation, not floating beyond the side wall; verify sealing sweep and motion separately.

Keep metric sizes, support section/material, hidden hardpoints, fastener count/type and exact 1977 MAZ543A applicability OPEN. Current model coordinates and the photographic visual fit are not factory dimensions.
rights: Research-local photographs and crops only. Do not add source pixels to public repository or assets. Cite creator and exact source page if publishing factual observations.
